what_it_does: Starting in December 2026, the Discover page and domains will be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. Discover is a curated browsing experience that helps users find assets across Databricks without requiring deep knowledge of catalog hierarchies. Use domains and subdomains to organize assets such as tables, dashboards, notebooks, and Genie Agents by business area, highlight key assets with custom curation, and explore AI recommended assets.
